title: Rama tries to pacify Lakshmana further
introduction: In this chapter Rama further tries to pacify Lakshmana and tells him that his stay in forest is the will of gods. He also wants all the celebration for his coronation to be stopped.
closing: || इत्यार्षे श्र्रिमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्वाविंशः सरगः ||
Thus the end of twenty second chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of Srimad Ramayana.

verses.devanagari:
अथ तम् व्यथया दीनम् सविशेषम् अमर्षितम् |
श्वसन्तम् इव नाग इन्द्रम् रोष विस्फारित ईक्षणम्
आसद्य रामः सौमित्रिम् सुह्ऱ्दम् भ्रातरम् प्रियम् |
उवाच इदम् स धैर्येण धारयन् सत्त्वम् आत्मवान्
verses.iast:
atha tam vyathayā dīnam saviśeṣam amarṣitam |
śvasantam iva nāga indram roṣa visphārita īkṣaṇam
āsadya rāmaḥ saumitrim suhRdam bhrātaram priyam |
uvāca idam sa dhairyeṇa dhārayan sattvam ātmavān
verses.translation: Afterwards ,the self composed Rama by controlling his thoughts with courage ,approached the kind -hearted and affectionate brother Lakshmana who was distressed with agony who was very much angry like a hissing king cobra ,with his eyes dilated with wrath and spoke the following words.

verses.devanagari:
निगृह्य रोषं शोकं च खैर्यमाश्रित्य केवलम् |
अवमानम् निरस्येमम् गृहीत्वा हर्षमुत्तमम्
उपक्लुप्तम् हि यत्किंचिदभिषेकार्थमद्य मे |
स्र्वम् विसर्जय क्षिप्रम् कुरु कार्यम् निरत्ययम्
verses.iast:
nigṛhya rośhaṃ śokaṃ ca khairyamāśritya kevalam |
avamānam nirasyemam gṛhītvā harśhamuttamam
upakluptam hi yatkiṃcidabhiśhekārthamadya me |
srvam visarjaya kśipram kuru kāryam niratyayam
verses.translation: " Hold back grief and anger. Forget this insult, by taking refuge in courage alone. Obtain great joy! Abandon all these arrangements made today for my coronation and immediately take up action that is faultless ."

verses.devanagari:
सौमित्रे यो अभिषेक अर्थे मम सम्भार सम्भ्रमः |
अभिषेक निवृत्ति अर्थे सो अस्तु सम्भार सम्भ्रमः
verses.iast:
saumitre yo abhiṣeka arthe mama sambhāra sambhramaḥ |
abhiṣeka nivṛtti arthe so astu sambhāra sambhramaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, Lakshmana! Show the same zeal now in terminating my coronation as the zeal shown earlier in preparations for my coronation."

verses.devanagari:
यस्या मद् अभिषेक अर्थम् मानसम् परितप्यते |
माता नः सा यथा न स्यात् सविशन्का तथा कुरु
verses.iast:
yasyā mad abhiṣeka artham mānasam paritapyate |
mātā naḥ sā yathā na syāt saviśankā tathā kuru
verses.translation: "My mother Kaikeyi is still agonized about my coronation. Behave in such a way that no apprehension comes to her mind on this matter."

verses.devanagari:
तस्याः शन्कामयम् दुह्खम् मुहूर्तम् अपि न उत्सहे |
मनसि प्रतिसम्जातम् सौमित्रे अहम् उपेक्षितुम्
verses.iast:
tasyāḥ śankāmayam duhkham muhūrtam api na utsahe |
manasi pratisamjātam saumitre aham upekṣitum
verses.translation: "Oh, Lakshmana! I do not wish to disregard the painful doubt in her mind even for a moment".

verses.devanagari:
न बुद्धि पूर्वम् न अबुद्धम् स्मरामि इह कदाचन |
मातृणाम् वा पितुर् वाहम् कृतम् अल्पम् च विप्रियम्
verses.iast:
na buddhi pūrvam na abuddham smarāmi iha kadācana |
mātṛṇām vā pitur vāham kṛtam alpam ca vipriyam
verses.translation: "I do not remember to have done even a small disagreeable thing here at any time to my mothers or to my father, either intentionally or unintentionally."

verses.devanagari:
सत्यः सत्य अभिसंधः च नित्यम् सत्य पराक्रमः |
पर लोक भयात् भीतः निर्भयो अस्तु पिता मम
verses.iast:
satyaḥ satya abhisaṃdhaḥ ca nityam satya parākramaḥ |
para loka bhayāt bhītaḥ nirbhayo astu pitā mama
verses.translation: "Let the promise made by my father ,who is truthful, who is truly mighty and who is afraid of the fear of the other world, become true .Let him be fearless."

glosses.meaning: the fear of the other world

verses.devanagari:
तस्य अपि हि भवेद् अस्मिन् कर्मणि अप्रतिसम्ह्ऱ्ते |
सत्यम् न इति मनः तापः तस्य तापः तपेच् च माम्
verses.iast:
tasya api hi bhaved asmin karmaṇi apratisamhRte |
satyam na iti manaḥ tāpaḥ tasya tāpaḥ tapec ca mām
verses.translation: "Our father will feel anguished that his word has not come true ,if this coronation is not withdrawn. His distress will cause pain to me."

glosses.meaning: his word has not come true
if this coronation is not with drawn

verses.devanagari:
अभिषेक विधानम् तु तस्मात् सम्हृत्य लक्ष्मण |
अन्वग् एव अहम् इच्चामि वनम् गन्तुम् इतः पुनः
verses.iast:
abhiṣeka vidhānam tu tasmāt samhṛtya lakṣmaṇa |
anvag eva aham iccāmi vanam gantum itaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, Lakshmana for that reason, I wish to go to forest immediately from her, by withdrawing, coronation arrangement."

verses.devanagari:
मम प्रव्राजनात् अद्य कृत कृत्या नृपात्मजा |
सुतम् भरतम् अव्यग्रम् अभिषेचयिता ततः
verses.iast:
mama pravrājanāt adya kṛta kṛtyā nṛpātmajā |
sutam bharatam avyagram abhiṣecayitā tataḥ
verses.translation: "Soon after my departure to the forest now, Kaikeyi having accomplished her purpose, will coolly get her son coronated."

glosses.meaning: due to my exile to forest

verses.devanagari:
मयि चीर अजिन धरे जटा मण्डल धारिणि |
गते अरण्यम् च कैकेय्या भविष्यति मनः सुखम्
verses.iast:
mayi cīra ajina dhare jaṭā maṇḍala dhāriṇi |
gate araṇyam ca kaikeyyā bhaviṣyati manaḥ sukham
verses.translation: "If go to forest , wearing deer -skin rags and with my hair twisted together Kaikeyi will have mental peace."

verses.devanagari:
बुद्धिः प्रणीता येन इयम् मनः च सुसमाहितम् |
तत् तु न अर्हामि सम्क्लेष्टुम् प्रव्रजिष्यामि माचिरम्
verses.iast:
buddhiḥ praṇītā yena iyam manaḥ ca susamāhitam |
tat tu na arhāmi samkleṣṭum pravrajiṣyāmi māciram
verses.translation: "I do not want to create trouble to my father, who has taken this hard decision in his mind . Hence, I will go to the forest at once

glosses.meaning: to cause trouble tam = to such father yena = by whom iyam = this buddhiH = decision praNiitam = was taken susamaahitam = with well composed manascha = mind maa = without chiram = delay."

verses.devanagari:
कृत अन्तः तु एव सौमित्रे द्रष्टव्यो मत् प्रवासने |
राज्यस्य च वितीर्णस्य पुनर् एव निवर्तने
verses.iast:
kṛta antaḥ tu eva saumitre draṣṭavyo mat pravāsane |
rājyasya ca vitīrṇasya punar eva nivartane
verses.translation: "Oh, Lakshmana! Look at it as destiny which has taken back kingdom given to me and which is sending me to exile"

glosses.meaning: It is perceivable kR^itaantastyaiva = as destiny mivartanecha = in taking back punaraiva = again raajyasya = of kingdom vitiirNasya = given. Matpravaasane = and in sending me to exile".

verses.devanagari:
कैकेय्याः प्रतिपत्तिर् हि कथम् स्यान् मम पीडने |
यदि भावो न दैवो अयम् कृत अन्त विहितः भवेत्
verses.iast:
kaikeyyāḥ pratipattir hi katham syān mama pīḍane |
yadi bhāvo na daivo ayam kṛta anta vihitaḥ bhavet
verses.translation: -"If not making of destiny to create such a thought in Kaikeyi, how come she resolved to harass?"

glosses.meaning: If not for kR^itaanta vihitaH = making of destiny
this bhaavaH = thought tasyaaH = in her
how syaat = perhaps pratipattiH = resolution kaikeyyaaH = to Kaikeyi piidane = to herass mama = me

verses.devanagari:
जानासि हि यथा सौम्य न मातृषु मम अन्तरम् |
भूत पूर्वम् विशेषो वा तस्या मयि सुते अपि वा
verses.iast:
jānāsi hi yathā saumya na mātṛṣu mama antaram |
bhūta pūrvam viśeṣo vā tasyā mayi sute api vā
verses.translation: "You know that I had no discrimination among mothers and Kaikeyi also in the past had no discrimination between me and her son Bharata"

glosses.meaning: how na bhuutapuurvam = that in the past
discrimination mama = to me maatR^ishu = among mothers. tasyaaH = to her
particularly mayi = either in me sute api vaa = or in her son Bharata."

verses.devanagari:
सो अभिषेक निवृत्ति अर्थैः प्रवास अर्थैः च दुर्वचैः |
उग्रैः वाक्यैः अहम् तस्या न अन्यद् दैवात् समर्थये
verses.iast:
so abhiṣeka nivṛtti arthaiḥ pravāsa arthaiḥ ca durvacaiḥ |
ugraiḥ vākyaiḥ aham tasyā na anyad daivāt samarthaye
verses.translation: "I do not perceive any other reason than an accident that made Kaikeyi to abolish my coronation , to send me to exile ,and to speak ferocious words ,not to be talked about."

glosses.meaning: I na samarthaye = do not perceive anyat = any other thing daivaat = than an accident tasyaaH vaakyaiH = for her words
intended for abolishion of my coronation
desirous of sending me to exile
and are not to be talked about."

verses.devanagari:
कथम् प्रकृति सम्पन्ना राज पुत्री तथा अगुणा |
ब्रूयात् सा प्राकृता इव स्त्री मत् पीडाम् भर्तृ सम्निधौ
verses.iast:
katham prakṛti sampannā rāja putrī tathā aguṇā |
brūyāt sā prākṛtā iva strī mat pīḍām bhartṛ samnidhau
verses.translation: "If it is for not an accidental reason, how Kaikeyi who is of a perfect temperament and who is born in a royal family can tell like a common woman to her husband to create trouble for me ?"

glosses.meaning: How saa = she prakR^itisampannaa = who is of a perfect nature tathaaguNaa = and such good qualities
who was princess bruuyaat = can tell praakR^itaa atriiva = like common woman
before husband matpiidaam = for my trouble?"

verses.devanagari:
यद् अचिन्त्यम् तु तत् दैवम् भूतेष्व् अपि न हन्यते |
व्यक्तम् मयि च तस्याम् च पतितः हि विपर्ययः
verses.iast:
yad acintyam tu tat daivam bhūteṣv api na hanyate |
vyaktam mayi ca tasyām ca patitaḥ hi viparyayaḥ
verses.translation: "The influence of destiny is un imaginable. No living being can counteract its influence. An adverse fate has befallen on me and on her .It is clear now ."

glosses.meaning: which daivam = destiny achintyam = is unimaginable tat = that na hanyete = can not be counteracted bhuuteshhvapi = by any living beings viparyayaH = adverse fate patitaH = befall
in me tasyaamcha = and in her vyaktam = It is clear."

verses.devanagari:
कश्चित् दैवेन सौमित्रे योद्धुम् उत्सहते पुमान् |
यस्य न ग्रहणम् किंचित् कर्मणो अन्यत्र दृश्यते
verses.iast:
kaścit daivena saumitre yoddhum utsahate pumān |
yasya na grahaṇam kiṃcit karmaṇo anyatra dṛśyate
verses.translation: "Oh, Lakshmana! There is no means whatsoever to abstain from it otherwise than to follow the course of destiny. Who will be able to fight against the destiny. ?"

glosses.meaning: which man utsahate = will be able yoddhum = to fight against daivena = destiny? kanchit = whatever anyatra = other thing na dR^ishyate = is not being seen karmaNaH = that to follow its course grahaNam = accepting yasya = of which destiny."

verses.devanagari:
सुख दुह्खे भय क्रोधौ लाभ अलाभौ भव अभवौ |
यस्य किंचित् तथा भूतम् ननु दैवस्य कर्म तत्
verses.iast:
sukha duhkhe bhaya krodhau lābha alābhau bhava abhavau |
yasya kiṃcit tathā bhūtam nanu daivasya karma tat
verses.translation: "Pleasure and pain, fear and anger, gain and loss, birth and death and such other things are all the acts of destiny"

glosses.meaning: pleasure and pain. bhaya krodhou = fear and anger labhaalabhou = gain and loss
what ever other thing tathaabhuutam = of such nature tat = that karmanamu = indeed is action daivasya = of destiny

verses.devanagari:
ऋषयो प्युग्रतपसो दैवेनाभिप्रपीडिताः |
उत्सृज्य नियमाम् स्तीव्रान् भ्रश्यन्ते काममन्युभिः
verses.iast:
ṛśhayo pyugratapaso daivenābhiprapīḍitāḥ |
utsṛjya niyamām stīvrān bhraśyante kāmamanyubhiḥ
verses.translation: "Even sages, who performed sever penance, having been harassed by destiny leave aside restraint and get ruined by lust and anger."

glosses.meaning: get ruined kaamamanyubhiH = by lust and anger."

verses.devanagari:
असम्क्ल्पितमेवेह यदकस्मात् प्रवर्तते |
निवर्त्यारम्भमारब्धम् ननु दैवस्य कर्म तत्
verses.iast:
asamklpitameveha yadakasmāt pravartate |
nivartyārambhamārabdham nanu daivasya karma tat
verses.translation: "It is indeed an act of destiny which suddenly and unimaginably obstructs an action, undertaken in the world ,at the starting point itself."

glosses.meaning: It daivasya karmananu = is indeed act of destiny
which prevents aarambham = effort aarabdham = undertaken iha = in this world yat = which pravartate

verses.devanagari:
एतया तत्त्वया बुद्ध्या संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना |
व्याहते अपि अभिषेके मे परितापो न विद्यते
verses.iast:
etayā tattvayā buddhyā saṃstabhyātmānamātmanā |
vyāhate api abhiṣeke me paritāpo na vidyate
verses.translation: "Although my coronation is obstructed, I have no grief since I have restrained the self by myself with real consciousness."

glosses.meaning: There is no paritaapaH = grief me = to me samtabhyaatmaanamaat manaa = since I have restrained the self by the self
with this intellect tattvayaa = which is real."

verses.devanagari:
तस्मात् अपरितापः संस् त्वम् अपि अनुविधाय माम् |
प्रतिसम्हारय क्षिप्रम् आभिषेचनिकीम् क्रियाम्
verses.iast:
tasmāt aparitāpaḥ saṃs tvam api anuvidhāya mām |
pratisamhāraya kṣipram ābhiṣecanikīm kriyām
verses.translation: "Hence ,you also ,like me, get the arrangements for coronation withdrawn immediately without any anguish"

glosses.meaning: get withdrawn kriyaam = the execution abhishhechanikiim = relating to coronation kshhipram = immediately aparitaapaH = without agony."

verses.devanagari:
एभिरेव घटैः सर्वैरभिषेचनसम्भृतैः |
मम लक्स्मण तापस्ये व्रतस्नानम् भविष्यति
verses.iast:
ebhireva ghaṭaiḥ sarvairabhiśhecanasambhṛtaiḥ |
mama laksmaṇa tāpasye vratasnānam bhaviśhyati
verses.translation: Oh, Lakshmana! Let all these very pots of water arranged for coronation be used by me for my bath after completing the religious vow of asceticism."

glosses.meaning: All eohiH = these ghataireva = very pots abhishhechana sambR^itaiH = arranged for coronation bhavishhyati = become vratasnaanam = bath after completing religious vow taapasye = of asceticism mama = to me."

verses.devanagari:
अथवा किम् ममैतेन राजद्रव्यमयेन तु |
उद्धृतम् मे स्वयम् तो यम् व्रतादेशम् करिष्यति
verses.iast:
athavā kim mamaitena rājadravyamayena tu |
uddhṛtam me svayam to yam vratādeśam kariśhyati
verses.translation: "Otherwise ,why to me this water in these pots ,which is royal property? The water drawn out by myself ,will be used for my bath after completing the religious vow."

glosses.meaning: what use mama = to me etena = this water in pots raajadravyena = which is royal property? toyam = the water uddhR^itam = drawn out svayam = by myself karishhyati = will do vrataadesham = imposition of the vow me = to me."

verses.devanagari:
मा च लक्ष्मण सम्तापम् कार्षीर्लक्ष्म्या विपर्यये |
राज्यम् वा वनवासो वा वनवासो महोदयः
verses.iast:
mā ca lakśmaṇa samtāpam kārśhīrlakśmyā viparyaye |
rājyam vā vanavāso vā vanavāso mahodayaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, Lakshmana! Do not repent about this perverseness of Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth. When you talk of kingdom or dwelling in the forest, this is the final beautitude."

glosses.meaning: do not cultivate santaapam = repentence viparyaye = about perverseness lakshhmajaaH = of Lakshmi

glosses.itrans: the goddess of wealth raajyam vaa
glosses.iast: the goddess of vealth rājyam vā
glosses.devanagari: थे गोद्देस्स् ओf वेअल्थ् राज्यं वा
glosses.meaning: kingdom or vanavaasovaa = dwelling in forest
forest dwelling is indeed mahodayaH = final beautitude."

verses.devanagari:
न लक्ष्मण अस्मिन् मम राज्य विघ्ने |
माता यवीयस्य् अतिशन्कनीया |
दैव अभिपन्ना हि वदन्ति अनिष्टम् |
जानासि दैवम् च तथा प्रभावम्
verses.iast:
na lakṣmaṇa asmin mama rājya vighne |
mātā yavīyasy atiśankanīyā |
daiva abhipannā hi vadanti aniṣṭam |
jānāsi daivam ca tathā prabhāvam
verses.translation: "Oh, Lakshmana! Do not suspect our mother for obstruction of coronation ceremony. She is uttering evil words, being overpowered by destiny. You are aware of this destiny, which has such influence."

glosses.meaning: our younger mother na atisaNkaniiyaa = is not worthy of suspicion asmin karmavighne = in this obstruction of ceremony. vadatiHi = she is indeed uttering amishhTam = the evil daivaabhipaunaa = being over powered by destiny. jaanaasi = You know daivamcha = also the destiny
